Select exact IC50 activity rows for human prostaglandin G/H synthase 2 (CHEMBL230). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, and compound_records. Join compound_structures to obtain canonical_smiles. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL230 and standard_type IC50. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate.
